title: A Genetic Algorithm for Generating Extreme Examples in Arithmetic Dynamics
summary: We describe a genetic algorithm to find extreme examples in the arithmetic of dynamical systems. The algorithm is applied to four problems: small (non-zero) canonical heights, many rational preperiodic points, long rational cycles, and long rational tails. Data is provided for extreme examples generated for polynomials up to degree 13 and rational functions up to degree 5.
